hq.match: Match each car brand to the city where it is headquartered.

hq.all: Tap all {n} car brands headquartered in {value}.

rows.label: Stellantis
rows.hook: was formed by merging the makers of Chrysler and Peugeot into one giant multi-brand carmaker

rows.label: BMW
rows.hook: builds cars with a blue-and-white roundel and the slogan "the ultimate driving machine"

rows.label: Ford Motor Company
rows.hook: pioneered the moving assembly line and built the Model T and the Mustang

rows.label: General Motors
rows.hook: is the giant American automaker that owns Chevrolet, Buick and Cadillac

rows.label: Volkswagen
rows.description: German automotive brand; manufacturing subsidiary of Volkswagen Group
rows.hook: makes the Beetle and the Golf, and is Europe's best-selling carmaker

rows.label: Ferrari
rows.hook: builds red Italian supercars with a prancing horse badge and races in Formula One

rows.label: Lamborghini
rows.hook: builds wedge-shaped supercars with a raging bull on the badge, like the Countach

rows.label: Porsche
rows.description: German automobile manufacturer specializing in high-performance sports cars, SUVs and sedans, owned by Volkswagen AG
rows.hook: makes the rear-engined 911 sports car, one of the most recognisable shapes on the road

rows.label: Geely
rows.hook: is a fast-growing Chinese carmaker that owns Volvo and a stake in Lotus

rows.label: Jaguar Cars
rows.hook: makes sleek British luxury saloons and sports models with a leaping cat mascot, like the E-Type

rows.label: Škoda Auto
rows.description: automotive manufacturing subsidiary of Volkswagen Group
rows.hook: is a Czech carmaker known for practical, good-value cars like the Octavia and Fabia

rows.label: Volvo Cars
rows.hook: is known for safety innovations such as the three-point seatbelt

rows.label: Audi AG
rows.description: German automotive manufacturing subsidiary of Volkswagen Group
rows.hook: uses four interlocking rings as its badge and "quattro" for its all-wheel drive

rows.label: Hyundai Motor Company
rows.hook: makes the Sonata and Elantra and is one of the biggest carmakers in Asia

rows.label: Kia
rows.hook: sells the Sportage and Soul and is known for its long warranties

rows.label: Lexus
rows.description: Japanese brand of luxury vehicle owned by Toyota Motor Corporation
rows.hook: is the luxury division of the world's best-selling automaker, Toyota

rows.label: Aston Martin Lagonda
rows.hook: builds the elegant sports cars that James Bond drives

rows.label: Chevrolet
rows.hook: sells the Corvette sports car and the Silverado pickup with a golden bowtie badge

rows.label: Renault
rows.hook: is a French carmaker behind the Clio and the Twingo, with a diamond-shaped badge

rows.label: Cadillac
rows.hook: is the American luxury brand behind the Escalade SUV and long-finned classics

rows.label: Saab Automobile
rows.hook: made quirky turbocharged cars and jet fighters before shutting down

rows.label: Jeep
rows.hook: builds rugged off-road SUVs like the Wrangler, descended from a World War II military vehicle

rows.label: Lotus Cars
rows.description: British manufacturer of sports and racing cars
rows.hook: builds lightweight British sports models and was once a Formula One powerhouse

rows.label: Alfa Romeo
rows.hook: is a sporty Italian brand with a serpent-and-cross badge

rows.label: Opel
rows.description: German automobile manufacturer, subsidiary of Stellantis
rows.hook: sells the Corsa and Astra hatchbacks and is now owned by Stellantis

rows.label: Bentley
rows.hook: hand-builds luxurious grand tourers like the Continental GT, with a winged "B" badge

rows.label: Koenigsegg
rows.description: Swedish manufacturer of high-performance sports cars
rows.hook: builds hypercars such as the Agera and Jesko, among the fastest road cars ever

rows.label: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars
rows.hook: makes ultra-luxury saloons topped with the Spirit of Ecstasy hood ornament

rows.label: Suzuki Motor Corporation
rows.hook: makes small cars and motorcycles, including the Swift and the Hayabusa

rows.label: Mercedes-Benz Group
rows.hook: builds luxury cars marked by a three-pointed star in a circle

rows.label: Buick
rows.description: luxury car brand of General Motors
rows.hook: is a mid-luxury General Motors brand with three "ventiports" on classic models

rows.label: Mahindra & Mahindra
rows.hook: is an Indian maker of tractors and rugged SUVs like the Thar

rows.label: Fiat
rows.hook: makes the tiny 500 city car and the Panda

rows.label: Dacia
rows.description: brand and romanian car manufacturer from Renault
rows.hook: sells low-priced cars like the Duster and Sandero and is owned by Renault

rows.label: Pagani Automobili
rows.hook: hand-builds carbon-fibre hypercars like the Zonda and Huayra

rows.label: Isuzu
rows.hook: is known for trucks and diesel engines, and once sold the Trooper SUV

rows.label: Holden
rows.description: Australian subsidiary of General Motors, an automaker
rows.hook: was the iconic Australian brand behind the Commodore and the Ute, now retired

rows.label: Alpine
rows.hook: is the sporty brand behind the A110 coupe and an F1 team, owned by Renault

rows.label: Lancia
rows.hook: is a rally legend whose Delta Integrale dominated the World Rally Championship

rows.label: Groupe PSA
rows.hook: was the maker of Peugeot and Citroen cars before merging into Stellantis

rows.label: Daihatsu
rows.hook: specialises in tiny "kei" cars and is owned by Toyota

rows.label: DAF
rows.description: Netherlands branch of American manufacturer Paccar
rows.hook: builds heavy trucks seen across Europe and is owned by Paccar
